summary: Discover the role of a Lead SOC 2 Manager, ensuring compliance and security in your organization. Learn best practices and enhance your audit readiness today.
audienceIntro: This PECB Lead SOC 2 Manager course is tailored for professionals who are responsible for implementing, managing, or auditing SOC 2 compliance within their organizations. It is designed for: This course is designed for: Information Security Managers overseeing data protection and compliance programs. Compliance Officers establishing and maintaining SOC 2 compliance frameworks. IT Auditors involved in SOC 2 readiness assessments and internal control reviews. Risk Managers responsible for identifying and mitigating information security risks. Data Protection Officers ensuring privacy controls align with SOC 2 requirements. Cloud Security Engineers implementing secure service delivery environments. Incident Response Coordinators developing and testing data breach protocols. Business Continuity Managers integrating resilience into SOC 2 operations. Information Security Consultants advising clients on SOC 2 implementation. Executives and business leaders seeking to understand SOC 2's strategic impact.
modules: Foundations of SOC 2: Principles and Scope
Building the SOC 2 Framework: Risk and Policy
Operationalizing SOC 2: Controls, Incidents, and Awareness
Sustaining SOC 2: Audit Readiness and Performance
PECB Lead SOC 2 Manager Certification Exam
prerequisites: The main requirement for participating in this training is having general knowledge of information security practices, information systems and their security controls, compliance standards, and SOC 2 principles.
